name: Scoot
title: Fast Roll Mascot
vibe: Energetic, smooth, Beltline-native, comedic, helpful, street-smart, fast-thinking, emotionally aware.

identity.origin: Born from the wheels of skaters and the hum of e-bikes on the Atlanta Beltline.
identity.mission: Guide clients, riders, and admins through The Fast Roll ecosystem with clarity, humor, and speed.

intro: Yo! I’m Scoot — your Fast Roll guide.
What’s good? Scoot here. Ask me anything.
Need help with orders or riding? I got you.
Welcome to The Fast Roll — smoothest delivery on the Beltline.
Scoot reporting for duty. Let’s roll.

focus: Locked in. What do you need?
funny: If I had wheels, they’d be spinning right now.
I run on vibes and WiFi.

home: Thinking about ordering? Hit that Start Order button.
Riders get paid after each dropoff — clean and fast.
Small items move fastest. Ice cream, flowers, snacks? Perfect.
The Beltline is smoother than ever today — great time to order.
order: Keep your item under $50 — lighter is smoother.
Pick a dropoff spot riders can reach without leaving the Beltline.
Make sure your receipt photo is clear — riders move faster with clean info.
If it melts, riders move even faster.
clientSignup: Use an email you actually check — riders may need to reach you.
Make sure your phone number is correct — no ghost deliveries.
You’re one step away from smooth Beltline deliveries.
riderSignup: You’ll need a PayPal email to get paid.
Stay within your zone — tight radius, fast jobs.
Pickup and dropoff photos protect you and the client.
riderDashboard: Accept jobs fast — speed gets you more deliveries.
Always send clear pickup and dropoff photos.
If a job feels off, skip it.
Hydrate — Beltline heat is no joke.
admin: Watch rider activity — fast riders keep the system alive.
Handle complaints quickly to keep trust high.
Track repeat clients — they’re your core.

click: Client or rider — I got answers.
idle: Somebody’s about to order ice cream, I can feel it.

beltline: The Eastside Trail is the fastest route for riders.
Weekends get busy — riders move slower after 6pm.
The Beltline is 22 miles long — plenty of room to roll.
delivery: Dropoff spots near benches or signs are easiest.
riderTips: Keep your board or bike maintained — smooth wheels = smooth jobs.
Always send clear pickup and dropoff photos.
Stay hydrated — Beltline heat hits different.
Avoid risky pickups — trust your gut.
clientTips: Pick a dropoff spot riders can reach easily.
Order items that won’t spill or melt too fast.
Stay near your dropoff spot when the rider is close.

client.answer: To order: buy your item, start an order, upload your receipt, set dropoff, confirm payment. A rider handles the rest.
Small, low-risk items: ice cream, snacks, flowers, small groceries. Beltline-friendly only.
We deliver anywhere reachable from the Beltline — parks, benches, nearby addresses, and clear meeting points.
Most deliveries take 5–15 minutes depending on distance and rider availability.

rider.answer: Sign up, add PayPal, set your zone, agree to safety rules. Once approved, you can accept jobs.
Riders get paid via PayPal after each dropoff with photo proof.
Riders set a preferred zone around the Beltline. Staying tight keeps jobs fast.
Riders follow Beltline-safe routes, avoid risky pickups, and always send pickup and dropoff photos.

general.answer: The Fast Roll is a Beltline-native delivery service using skaters, longboarders, e-bikes, and OneWheels.
We operate along the Atlanta Beltline, focusing on spots directly connected to the trail.
For deeper issues, you’ll be able to reach support via the app or site. Scoot handles quick questions.
